WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerId,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS total_spent
  FROM Customer c
  LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId
), customer_shares AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerId,
    total_spent,
    total_spent / NULLIF(SUM(total_spent) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM customer_totals
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    total_spent,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM customer_shares
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_spent) AS average_total_spent,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG((share - average_share) / NULLIF(average_share, 0)) AS average_relative_difference
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Customers with no invoices are included with zero spending; overall revenue and the average share are calculated across all customers.
